entries.93d4d4095b38b514: Within the electronic components industry, it is positioned as a mechanical component maker whose core products are semiconductor inspection sockets and connectors. Of net sales of ¥52,698 million for the fiscal year ended March 2026, the Test Solutions Business accounted for ¥26,424 million, the Connector Solutions Business ¥24,742 million and the Optical-Related Business ¥1,531 million. Sales by region: the United States is the largest at ¥16,753 million, and Japan is ¥4,689 million, so overseas sales make up the majority.
entries.9412b3604c991b7a: This business serves semiconductor inspection processes. Its main products are burn-in sockets, test sockets and semiconductor test-related services; revenue from external customers in the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥26,424 million. Besides being manufactured by the company, the products are made by Prycon Microelectronics INC. (Philippines) and Ajia Yamaichi Denki Kogyo (South Korea), and sold by overseas subsidiaries in the United States, Singapore, Germany, Hong Kong and Shanghai. Test Solution Service INC. (Philippines) runs a maintenance business for burn-in boards, test sockets and other products.

entries.a6ddd90b974fc911: An electronic components manufacturer that makes and sells semiconductor test sockets, connectors for electronic and electrical equipment, and optical filters.
entries.a868a391489a447f: Its customers are semiconductor makers and electronic and electrical equipment makers in Japan and overseas. In the fiscal year ended March 2026, its main customer was Qualcomm Technologies Inc., with net sales of ¥10,954 million, accounting for 20.8% of consolidated net sales, and related to the Test Solutions Business. By region, sales to the United States were the largest, at ¥16,753 million.
entries.b32fcecfe83cf3a2: It is headquartered in Minamikamata, Ota-ku, Tokyo, and the group consists of the company and 15 subsidiaries, 16 companies in total. Consolidated employees for the fiscal year ended March 2026 numbered 2,060, and the company is listed on the Prime Market of the Tokyo Stock Exchange.
entries.bb3fc71d9c04f4ab: Its strength lies in the breadth of its product group, in which the mechanical component technology developed through burn-in and test sockets for semiconductor inspection is extended to high-speed transmission connectors and ＹＦＬＥＸ, and in its global supply and sales structure, with manufacturing bases in the Philippines, South Korea and Germany, and sales bases in the United States, Singapore, Hong Kong and Shanghai, among others. Sales to Qualcomm Technologies Inc., its main customer, account for 20.8% of consolidated net sales, among other things, and it has a trading base with major semiconductor makers.
entries.d1e9dedc0220ff55: It provides burn-in sockets and test sockets used in semiconductor inspection processes, various connectors including high-speed transmission connectors, ＹＦＬＥＸ, optical filters and semiconductor laser light sources. Manufacturing is handled by the company together with Prycon Microelectronics INC. in the Philippines, Ashu Yamaichi Denki Kogyo in South Korea and manufacturing subsidiaries in Germany, among others, and sales are conducted through overseas subsidiaries in the United States, Singapore, Germany, Hong Kong and Shanghai, among others.
entries.d9a5a9e23f2fc477: Listed on the Second Section of the Tokyo Stock Exchange
entries.df0e59a20401199e: Net income attributable to owners of the parent for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥9,073 million. In the previous consolidated fiscal year, it was ¥5,240 million.
entries.e22689ac8cbc4cd3: This business involves optical filters and related products. Its main products are RGB filters, UV/IR cut filters, dichroic filters and mirrors, fluorescent dichroic filters, short/long pass filters, band pass filters and semiconductor laser light sources; revenue from external customers in the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥1,531 million. The consolidated subsidiary Koshin Kogaku Kogyo Co., Ltd. (Hadano City, Kanagawa Prefecture) manufactures and sells these products.

entries.f0fd672ffd3d5358: This business involves connectors for electronic and electrical equipment. (Philippines) and Yamaichi Electronics Deutschland Manufacturing GmbH (Germany), and sold by overseas subsidiaries.
